title: Postcard and Vow
author: Q. M. Crane
blurb: Gideon Montrose, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
